scope: Actual gate/up weights with natural M256/M512 routing replay; inclusive BF16-to-D8 producer pack plus selected gate/up.
candidate: Prefetch four of the next K32 interval's eight raw T16 nibble words and demand-load the remaining four.
command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q4_k_mmq_leaf_bench.py --rows 256,512 --modes t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf,t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf-rawprefetch-p4,t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf-rawprefetch-p8 --warmups 4 --samples 41 --burst 3 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-q4-raw-prefetch-p4-leaf.json
decision: Reject and remove P4. Partial coverage does not preserve P8's M512 latency-hiding benefit and is slower at both measured shapes.
